blind_disposition: Item 2 (Haine + Dattelpalmen read as tautology; proposed «Unterwegs in den Palmenhainen») REJECTED: the proposal drops البساتين/orchards, which the owner chose deliberately, and «Palmenhaine» is reserved by the termbase for literal en «palm groves». The overlap the reader senses is in the source itself (ar «البساتين والنخيل»; the oasis groves contain palms), and the termbase entry «groves (of the oasis) -> die Haine» records that the Haine also carry lime, fig and pomegranate, so the coordination names two distinct things. Haine kept over «Obstgärten»: ar البساتين is rendered «Haine» in 8 published de sentences across 5 blog pages (jabal-qarah, worth-visiting x2, souvenirs, hasawi-lomi x3, hasawi-lomi-history) behind en «groves»; «Obstgärten» appears nowhere in published de or the termbase and would be a third rendering of one Arabic word (and suggests temperate fruit orchards); «Gärten» is bound to حديقة (Parks und Gärten, der kommunale Garten). Item 31 (footer «eine Geschichte» flat; «Eine Oase voller Geschichte. Unterwegs in ihren Palmenhainen.») REJECTED: first sentence inherited and outside the batch; second half drops orchards (as item 2); the footer keeps the source's deliberate repeat of the hero. Reader raised no objection to the removal of plural «Oasen». Other items (1, 3-30, 32-34) out of scope, inherited, raised to Eyad unscored.
